stories.title: This week's new music: Skee Mask, MJ Nebreda, Valentina Magaletti
stories.summary: RA's weekly round-up of ten new releases includes Skee Mask's three-track 'Peacemanagement' on Ilian Tape (out 26 Nov), aimed at early-morning dancefloors, and 'Triptych 1' by Daisy Moon, Or:la and D. Tiffany on Off-Kilter (out 27 Nov), the first of a three-part series. Other picks include Conclave's soulful house 'Time And Space' on Love Injection with a Karizma remix, Asphalt DJ's 'Work Out' EP on Paryìa with an AIDA remix, and a 22-track Group Therapy World AIDS Day '26 compilation out 4 Dec.

stories.title: Mix Of The Day: Mika Siponen
stories.summary: Mika Siponen recorded a mix for Hamburg collective PHANTASIA that explores the 'quietly psychedelic history' of Detroit label Underground Resistance. It also takes in wider Detroit house and techno.
